<GroupInfoItem Name="TextDisplayGroup">
	   <Items>
		 <Category Name="文本显示">
                    <Items>
                        <StringConfig Name="Content" NameSpace="Standard">
                            <Description>RunParam_Content</Description>
                            <DisplayName>RunParam_Content</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
                            <CurValue />
                            <DefaultValue />
                            <Length>0x00000020</Length>
                            <PropertyName>Value</PropertyName>
                            <BrigdgeSetter>
                                <TargetName>BridgeObj</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetDisplayObjectFeatureOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>Show Text;Content</OperationParams>
                            </BrigdgeSetter>
                        </StringConfig>
                        <ColorConfig Name="OKColor">
                            <Description>OK颜色</Description>
                            <DisplayName>OK颜色</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
                            <PropertyName>okcolor</PropertyName>
                            <BrigdgeSetter>
                                <TargetName>BridgeObj</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetDisplayObjectOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>Show Text</OperationParams>
                            </BrigdgeSetter>
                        </ColorConfig>
                        <ColorConfig Name="NGColor">
                            <Description>NG颜色</Description>
                            <DisplayName>NG颜色</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
                            <PropertyName>ngcolor</PropertyName>
                            <BrigdgeSetter>
                                <TargetName>BridgeObj</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetDisplayObjectOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>Show Text</OperationParams>
                            </BrigdgeSetter>
                        </ColorConfig>
                        <FloatConfig Name="CharacterSize" NameSpace="Standard">
                            <Description>字号</Description>
                            <DisplayName>字号</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
                            <MinValue>6</MinValue>
                            <MaxValue>72</MaxValue>
                            <IncValue>1</IncValue>
                            <PropertyName>Value</PropertyName>
                            <BrigdgeSetter>
                                <TargetName>BridgeObj</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetDisplayObjectFeatureOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>Show Text;FontSize</OperationParams>
                            </BrigdgeSetter>
                        </FloatConfig>
                        <FloatConfig Name="Transparency">
                            <Description>透明度</Description>
                            <DisplayName>透明度</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
                            <MinValue>0</MinValue>
                            <MaxValue>1</MaxValue>
                            <IncValue>0.1</IncValue>
                            <PropertyName>opacity</PropertyName>
                            <BrigdgeSetter>
                                <TargetName>BridgeObj</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetDisplayObjectOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>Show Text</OperationParams>
                            </BrigdgeSetter>
                        </FloatConfig>
						<ButtonSelecter Name="PositionX">
							<Description>位置X</Description>
                            <DisplayName>位置X</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
							<DropOpenSetter>
                                <TargetName>EnumEntrys</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetFrontAndSelfFilterTreeOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>int;float</OperationParams>
                            </DropOpenSetter>
							<Triggers>
								<Trigger>
									<Property>CurValue</Property>
									<Setters>
										<Setter>
											<OperationName>SetResultIOToModuleOperation</OperationName>
											<OperationParams>DisplayoutputPositionX;float</OperationParams>
										</Setter>																				
									</Setters>
								</Trigger>								
							</Triggers>
							<Initers>
								<Setter>
									<TargetName>CurValue</TargetName>
									<OperationName>GetSelectedDisplayFilterOperation</OperationName>
									<OperationParams>DisplayoutputPositionX</OperationParams>
								</Setter>
							</Initers>
						</ButtonSelecter>
						<ButtonSelecter Name="PositionY">
							<Description>位置Y</Description>
                            <DisplayName>位置Y</DisplayName>
                            <Visibility>Beginner</Visibility>
                            <AccessMode>O</AccessMode>
							<DropOpenSetter>
                                <TargetName>EnumEntrys</TargetName>
                                <OperationName>GetFrontAndSelfFilterTreeOperation</OperationName>
                                <OperationParams>int;float</OperationParams>
                            </DropOpenSetter>
							<Triggers>
								<Trigger>
									<Property>CurValue</Property>
									<Setters>
										<Setter>
											<OperationName>SetResultIOToModuleOperation</OperationName>
											<OperationParams>DisplayoutputPositionY;float</OperationParams>
										</Setter>										
									</Setters>
								</Trigger>
							</Triggers>
							<Initers>
								<Setter>
									<TargetName>CurValue</TargetName>
									<OperationName>GetSelectedDisplayFilterOperation</OperationName>
									<OperationParams>DisplayoutputPositionY</OperationParams>
								</Setter>
							</Initers>
						</ButtonSelecter>                        
                    </Items>
           </Category>
	   </Items>
	</GroupInfoItem>
requestedContract: Persist per-node display object settings separately from algorithm parameters.
Expose source image plus output mapping to host display, data record and result list consumers.
Support content template plus OK/NG colors (status zero NG), alpha, font6..72, position literal/subscribed number.
Original display PositionX/Y subscriptions use DisplayoutputPositionX/Y float inputs and int/float source filters.
Support explicit original NaN diagnostic values or define a visible compatibility boundary; do not turn NaN into zero.
